# coss ui for Svelte

> An unofficial Svelte 5 / SvelteKit port of [coss ui](https://coss.com/ui): accessible, composable components built on [ShardsUI](https://shardsui.com/) (a Svelte port of Base UI) and styled with [Tailwind CSS v4](https://tailwindcss.com/). Components are distributed as source through a shadcn-svelte compatible registry, so you copy, paste, and own them.

Key facts for agents:

- This is Svelte, not React. Write Svelte 5 components (runes: `$props`, `$state`, `$derived`), not JSX. Upstream coss.com docs and examples are React and do not apply verbatim.
- Primitives come from ShardsUI, not Bits UI or Radix. Component APIs follow Base UI conventions.
- Components import each other through the `#lib/*` Node subpath import (mapped to `./src/lib/*` in `package.json`). SvelteKit's `$lib` points at the same folder.
- Add a component, particle, bloc, or hook with the CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn-svelte@latest add https://cossui-svelte.com/r/<name>.json` (e.g. `button`, `p-button-1`, `use-is-mobile`).
- Import components from their barrel: `import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.ts";`
- Theme tokens extend shadcn's CSS variables with `--info`, `--success`, `--warning` (each with `-foreground`) and `--destructive-foreground`. Typography uses `--font-sans`, `--font-mono`, `--font-heading`.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs): What the library is and how it is built.
- [Get Started](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/get-started): Prerequisites, the `#lib` alias, adding components with the CLI or manually, fonts, and primitive exports.
- [Styling](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/styling): Color tokens, theming, and font variables.
- [Skills](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/skills): Agent skills that teach coding assistants coss ui APIs and conventions.
- [Chat UI](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/chat): Installing and composing the Chat UI family, with integration guidance and application responsibilities.
- [Changelog](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/changelog): Breaking changes, migration guides, and notable updates.
- [Roadmap](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/roadmap): Current state of the port and what comes next.

## Components

- [Accordion](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/accordion): A set of collapsible panels with headings and content.
- [Alert](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/alert): A callout for displaying important information.
- [Alert Dialog](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/alert-dialog): A dialog that requires user response to proceed.
- [Aspect Ratio](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/aspect-ratio): Displays content within a desired ratio.
- [Autocomplete](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/autocomplete): An input that suggests options as you type.
- [Avatar](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/avatar): An image element with a fallback for representing the user.
- [Badge](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/badge): A badge or a component that looks like a badge.
- [Breadcrumb](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/breadcrumb): Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.
- [Button](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/button): A button or a component that looks like a button.
- [Calendar](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/calendar): A date picker component with range and multi-select support.
- [Card](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/card): A content container for grouping related information.
- [Chart](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/chart): Charts built on LayerChart, themed through a shared config.
- [Checkbox](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/checkbox): A control allowing the user to toggle between checked and not checked.
- [Checkbox Group](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/checkbox-group): Provides shared state to a series of checkboxes.
- [Collapsible](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/collapsible): A collapsible panel controlled by a button trigger.
- [Color Picker](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/colorpicker): A specialized dropdown for selecting colors.
- [Combobox](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/combobox): An input combined with a list of predefined items to select.
- [Command](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/command): A command palette built with Dialog and Autocomplete for searching and executing commands.
- [Composer](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/composer): A composer for chat and AI assistant interfaces, with a growing input, persistent actions, and optional mentions or slash commands.
- [Context Menu](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/context-menu): A menu that appears at the pointer on right click or long press.
- [Cropper](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/cropper): An image cropper with zoom, drag and keyboard support.
- [Date Picker](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/date-picker): A date picker built with Calendar and Popover.
- [Dialog](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/dialog): A popup that opens on top of the entire page.
- [Drawer](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/drawer): A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen with swipe gestures, snap points, and nested drawer support.
- [Empty](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/empty): A container for displaying empty state information.
- [Field](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/field): Provides labelling and validation for form controls.
- [Fieldset](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/fieldset): A native fieldset element with a legend.
- [File Upload](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/file-upload): Drag-and-drop file upload built on the useFileUpload hook.
- [Form](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/form): A form wrapper that simplifies validation and submission.
- [Frame](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/frame): A framed container for grouping related information.
- [Group](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/group): Visually groups a series of controls.
- [Input](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/input): A native input element.
- [Input Group](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/input-group): Groups inputs with addons, buttons, and other elements.
- [Kbd](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/kbd): Displays keyboard keys and shortcuts.
- [Label](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/label): Renders an accessible label associated with controls.
- [Link Preview](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/link-preview): A popup that previews the content behind a link on hover.
- [Map](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/map): Interactive maps built on MapLibre GL, with markers, popups, routes and clusters.
- [Menu](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/menu): A list of actions in a dropdown, with keyboard navigation.
- [Meter](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/meter): A graphical display of a numeric value within a range.
- [Number Field](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/number-field): A numeric input with increment and decrement buttons, and a scrub area.
- [OTP Field](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/otp-field): A segmented input for one-time passwords and verification codes.
- [Pagination](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/pagination): Page navigation with next and previous links.
- [Places Autocomplete](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/places-autocomplete): An address autocomplete input powered by Google Places.
- [Popover](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/popover): An accessible popup anchored to a button.
- [Preview Card](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/preview-card): A popup that shows a preview when a link is hovered.
- [Progress](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/progress): Displays the status of a task that takes a long time.
- [Radio Group](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/radio-group): A set of checkable buttons where at most one can be checked at a time.
- [Scroll Area](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/scroll-area): A native scroll container with custom scrollbars.
- [Segmented Control](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/segmented-control): Presents related choices, navigation destinations, filters, or content views.
- [Select](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/select): Choose a predefined value from a dropdown menu.
- [Separator](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/separator): A separator element accessible to screen readers.
- [Sheet](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/sheet): A flyout that opens from the side of the screen, based on Dialog.
- [Sidebar](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/sidebar): A composable, collapsible sidebar with mobile support.
- [Skeleton](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/skeleton): A loading state placeholder.
- [Slider](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/slider): Select a value from within a given range.
- [Spinner](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/spinner): An indicator for a loading state.
- [Star Rating](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/starrating): An accessible star rating input with optional half-star support.
- [Stepper](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/stepper): Displays a series of steps in a process.
- [Switch](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/switch): A control that indicates whether a setting is on or off.
- [Table](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/table): Displays tabular data.
- [Tabs](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/tabs): Toggles between related panels on the same page.
- [Textarea](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/textarea): A native textarea element.
- [Timeline](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/timeline): Displays a series of events in chronological order.
- [Toast](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/toast): A temporary notification that informs users.
- [Toggle](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/toggle): A two-state button that can be toggled on or off.
- [Toggle Group](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/toggle-group): Provides shared state to a series of toggle buttons.
- [Toolbar](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/toolbar): A container for grouping buttons and controls.
- [Tooltip](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/tooltip): A popup that shows a hint when an element is hovered or focused.
- [Tree](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/components/tree): A hierarchical tree view with keyboard navigation and drag and drop, built on Headless Tree.

## Hooks

- [IsMobile](https://cossui-svelte.com/docs/hooks/use-is-mobile): Reactive flag that is true when the viewport is narrower than the mobile breakpoint.

Other hooks are available from the registry without a docs page: `use-uid`, `use-is-mac`, `use-character-limit`, `use-currency-input`, `use-file-upload`, `use-pkgmgr-config`.

## Examples

- [Particles](https://cossui-svelte.com/particles): Searchable catalog of ready-to-use component variants (`p-<component>-<n>`). Each one is at `https://cossui-svelte.com/particle/<id>`.
- [Blocs](https://cossui-svelte.com/blocs): Full page sections and app examples (login, signup, OTP, sidebar, calendar, chat, dashboards). Each one is at `https://cossui-svelte.com/blocs/view/<name>`.

## Registry

- [Registry index](https://cossui-svelte.com/r/registry.json): Every installable item (components, particles, blocs, hooks, utils) with its type, files, and dependencies.
- Item JSON: `https://cossui-svelte.com/r/<name>.json`, consumable by `shadcn-svelte add` or jsrepo.
- [AI & Registry](https://cossui-svelte.com/ai): Installation commands for each package manager.

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/cossui-svelte/cossui-svelte): The library and documentation site.
- [Upstream coss ui](https://coss.com/ui): The original React + Base UI library this port follows.
- [ShardsUI](https://shardsui.com/): The headless Svelte primitives underneath the components.
